title: Multi-tenant job board: a shared cache in front of tenant-scoped queries
name: Careers page cache

questions.prompt: Escalation from Globex: their careers page at /careers/backend-engineer is showing Acme's job ad, and candidates who applied through it ended up in Acme's recruiter inbox. Initech, which has no such job, sees the same ad instead of a 404. It comes and goes, roughly a minute at a time. Fix hiring/jobService.ts so the tests pass.
